name: NEURA Robotics
summary: NEURA Robotics makes collaborative robot arms, mobile robots and the 4NE1 humanoid. It was founded by David Reger.
funding: EUR 120 million Series B in January 2025; Wikipedia reports a Series C of up to $1.4 billion announced in June 2026.

sources.title: NEURA Robotics Raises EUR 120M in Series B Funding
